# Cascade — Data Pipeline Overhaul

- **Goal / definition of done:** re-architect the ingestion and transformation pipelines for 3x
  throughput and 40% lower cost, with data-quality SLAs, by **2026-12-15**.
- **Owner:** [Nadia Hassan](../people/nadia-hassan.md), Head of Data.
- **Status:** **on track**, pending a vendor decision.
- **Dependency:** the [Datalytix](../people/helena-braun.md) connector (reverse-ETL) and a new
  streaming vendor contract that [Marcus Feld](../people/marcus-feld.md) must approve.

## Open items

  before Maya signs (lock-in concern).
- Coordinates shared infra with [Raj Patel](../people/raj-patel.md)'s platform.
